component.name: Field
component.description: Generic field layout and accessibility primitive.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Field wrapper that links label, control, description, and messages.

slots.name: wrapper
slots.description: Inner wrapper that arranges label, control, helper text, and messages.

slots.name: labelWrapper
slots.description: Row that groups the field label and optional hint.

slots.name: label
slots.description: Accessible field label associated with the control.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field input is required.

slots.name: container
slots.description: Region that contains the wrapped form control.

dataAttributes.name: data-has-text
dataAttributes.description: State or slot attribute exposed for styling hooks and selectors.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Helper text associated with the control.

slots.name: error
slots.description: Validation error message region for the field.

slots.name: hint
slots.description: Short hint rendered beside the field label.

slots.name: help
slots.description: Additional guidance rendered below the control.

own.name: as
own.description: The HTML element or component to render as.

own.name: children
own.description: Children of the field, can be a render function.

own.name: class
own.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

own.name: description
own.description: Description text shown below the label.

own.name: disabled
own.description: Whether controls inherit a disabled state.

own.name: error
own.description: Custom error message or force error state.

own.name: help
own.description: Help text shown below the control when no error is present.

own.name: hint
own.description: Hint text shown near the label.

own.name: readOnly
own.description: Whether controls inherit a read-only state.

own.name: ref
own.type: JSX.HTMLElementTags["div"] extends { ref?: infer Ref; } ? Ref : never | undefined
